moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio shrink-fade-exit, written here): Icon tile scales 1 → 0.22 about its centre, opacity 1 → 0 and blur 0 → 3 px, together in 520 ms power2.in (easeInCubic); a 2.5 px dot marks the vanishing point for the last quarter and ~0.5 s after. Site return: 0.9 → 1 with fade-in, 400 ms power2.out. Params: duration (0.52 s) · scale (0.22) · blur (3 px) · ease (power2.in).
